findings.summary: The seal-verified Implement verification record accepts any systemctl exit code of 0 or 1 without checking that the raw state is running or degraded; a connection error returning 1 can therefore pass acceptance. The same authoritative record reports make verify exit 0 with 715/715 tests passed, but it does not establish the required connected-manager state.
The Implement verification record stores command arguments, exit codes, and test counts but omits the captured UTC values and raw systemctl and make verify output required as acceptance evidence.
